headline: Satisfactory quarter

highlights: Refer to Important Disclosures at the end of this report BUY National Stock Exchange Satisfactory quarter BFSI - Capital Markets  Result Update  November 04, 2026 CMP (Rs): 1,804 | TP (Rs): 2,050 NSE reported satisfactory performance in 2QFY27 despite the impact of CAS implementation.
Revenue from operations at Rs40.67bn declined ~11% qoq, led by ~16% decline in transaction charges owing to CAS implementation, but was offset by strong growth in Listing Services revenue at Rs1.5bn.
As a result, EBITDA at Rs30.79bn declined ~13% qoq, while EBITDA margin at 75.7% dipped sequentially.
The management believes the changes in CAS, expected to go live in Dec-26, should help investors trade more, thus driving volumes.
